assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope suggestive of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome.

Given the personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction, continuous mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to detect arrhythmic events and guide appropriate anticoagulation and rate-control management.
This clinical indication supports the medical necessity of CPT 93229.
The denial was based on reason code CO-197.
